fato_historico: 1944: World War II:  the Germans commence a counter offensive to retake the Nijmegen salient, this having been captured by the allies during Operation Market Garden.
energia_do_dia: The cosmic tides suggest a time for inner peace, Pisces. Just as history teaches us that even the most intense conflicts eventually shift toward resolution and bridge-building, you may find that today is a good time to release old tensions. Consider focusing on restorative practices that help you navigate your emotional currents with grace and renewed clarity.
frase_do_dia: Peace is the gentle bridge that connects our hearts to the vast universe.
significado_numero: Represents completion and the spiritual harmony of the cosmic cycles.
conselho: Trust your intuition and let go of what no longer serves your spirit.
